hook: Agar peepal ki chhaya ne naam pukara... to rooh uski hogi.
hook_text: Peepal ki chhaya ne naam pukara
feedback: Great pacing and strong visual contrast. The twist with Radha's inverted shadow ending the story lands with intense emotional weight and terror. Cut 8 and Cut 11 act as perfect silent beats to let the suspense breathe. REPEATS: an image is reused too often or twice in a row; use new inserts (hands, eyes, lantern, a clue) instead.
lines: Agar peepal ki chhaya ne naam pukara... to rooh uski hogi.
Aur uske pair... insano ki tarah seedhe nahi the.
Saran gaon mein raat ke dhai baje, sannata cheekh raha tha.
Atharah saal ki Radha ki neend ek meethi awaaz se khuli.
Uska chhota bhai Chhotu... sammohan mein peepal ki taraf badha ja raha tha.
Dadi ki chetawani yaad aate hi, Radha peetal ka lota lekar bhaagi!
Niyam saaf tha... jo paani dega, shraap usi par chadhega.
Mere bhai ko chhod de... ye paani main deti hoon!
Chhotu to bachkar ghar bhaag gaya...
Par Radha hamesha ke liye peepal se bandh gayi.
Subah ki dhoop mein... uski parchhai ke pair ulte ho chuke the.
Aur agar aaj raat tumhe koi naam se pukare... to jawab mat dena.
